paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing search to be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体对网络的使用量将是人类的 1000 倍，搜索必须为质量、成本与延迟重建，而非围绕人类点击。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, with Shapley values estimating content value for fair payment.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出人类点击数据是一种缺陷，应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并用 Shapley 值估算内容价值以实现公平付费。

paragagrawal.en: The ads business model will die with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, and search pricing should be 10x cheaper.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为广告商业模式会随智能体消亡，内容方须在推理时获得付费，搜索定价应便宜 10 倍。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; parametric memory is lossy, so agents always need fresh web search.
paragagrawal.zh: 他判断前沿模型持续变大而小模型性能触顶，参数记忆有损，因此智能体始终需要实时网络搜索。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and act, creating a parallel web for publishers.
paragagrawal.zh: 他预见网络从拉取转向推送，后台智能体持续监控变化并行动，形成面向发布者的平行网络。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用是降低入轨成本的关键，并以第一性原理思维作为突破性工程的根基。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Neuralink aims first at brain repair, then human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全寄望于监管与求真，并将 Neuralink 定位为先修复脑损伤、再实现人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive within a year or two.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他宣称正处在智能大爆炸的极早期，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital data centers and Optimus enable abundance and recursive manufacturing.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 将撞上地球电力墙，轨道数据中心与 Optimus 将带来丰裕与递归制造。

elon.en: Multiplanetary life and rigorous truth-seeking remain constant hedges against existential risk.
elon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：成为多行星物种，并让 AI 严格求真，以此对冲文明存续风险。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is unique value creation, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是创造独特价值，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model capability to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求将模型能力与任务相匹配。

satya.en: Agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; long-running agents require auditability, observability, security governance.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性和安全治理。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍对齐。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute Scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but stayed conservative.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 进步因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而高度可预测，并指出 Google 早在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，却因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: Containment is extremely difficult as models shrink and spread; existential risk is infinitesimally small, singularity centuries away.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他判断遏制极其困难，因为模型越来越小、越来越普及；同时认为存在性风险微乎其微，奇点远在数百年后，应聚焦近端能力。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; AI companions can deepen human bonds; model welfare is fringe.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他转向超级智能必须优先遏制与对齐，认为 AI 伴侣能深化人际关系，并将模型福利视为边缘议题。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; white-collar tasks automated in 12-18 months; red line on uncontrollable AI.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他主张微软必须独立构建前沿模型，白领任务将在 12-18 个月内被自动化，并为不可控 AI 划下红线。

aaronlevie.en: Application layer is where value shifts; model-to-workflow bridge is vast, so neolabs and enterprise agents matter more than chatbot UI.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年他强调创新正从模型层转向应用层：模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其庞大，因此应用型新实验室与后台智能体比聊天机器人界面更重要。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will absorb enterprise workflows, with humans reviewing results; systems of record must go headless and expose APIs.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年他判断长时运行的后台智能体将承接企业工作流，人类只审阅结果；记录系统必须走向无头化并向外部智能体暴露 API。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary and margins will normalize.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年他认为随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的，毛利率终将回归常态。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take far longer than Silicon Valley expects, because only code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年他提醒 AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多，因为只有代码是纯文本，其他领域缺乏这一属性。

aaronlevie.en: Pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword; labs serious about existential risk should nationalize AI, not slow down.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年他主张节奏与安全正交，"节奏"是个模糊的非词；真正相信存在性风险的实验室应国有化 AI，而非放慢速度。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; a neutral routing layer plus open-weight models and inference providers drive real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局：没有单一实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层加上开放权重模型与推理服务商，才能形成真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with fraud scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他提出代币（token）是新的价值单位，代币经济十年内或达 10 万亿美元，而欺诈与滥用也会随之同步放大，需要新的安全基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace's value; model diversity is durable.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他强调缩放定律对模型市场的价值是特性而非缺陷，模型多样性具有持久性——这与他更早对单一模型主导的怀疑一脉相承。

alexatallah.en: Inference providers are not commoditized; they innovate and differentiate, making tokens more efficient than hyperscalers.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他反驳推理服务已被商品化的看法：推理服务商持续创新与差异化，在速度与可用性上常胜过超大规模云厂商，让代币更高效。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; reselling inference with a markup is a fraud magnet, so discrete task pricing is the future.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他警告 AI 智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来，远超今日人类欺诈；加价转售推理是欺诈磁石，按离散任务定价才是未来。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution may arrive around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他判断消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却是有史以来最大的机会，真正的消费 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume new ideas almost always fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月，他反复强调“Proven, Better, New”框架：先复制已验证的产品，再做小幅改良，并预设新想法几乎必然失败。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; consumer apps are uninvestable now, while enterprise and prosumer markets look better.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他把分发视为根本，认为消费级应用因分发难题而不可投资，企业与专业消费者市场反而机会更好。

pincus.en: Picking the right body of water beats the right boat; AI is transformative and consumer AI TAM may exceed enterprise.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出选对水域比选对船更重要，认为 AI 具变革性，消费级 AI 的 TAM 可能远超企业级。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas; micromanage early, keep control, and test more ideas in a week than the industry tests in a year.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他深化为赢家直觉胜过想法本身：早期要微观管理、保持控制权，并在一周内测试比行业一年还多的想法。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible-but-wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他指出多数大模型是为人在环路的辅助而非可靠自动化而优化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，产出看似合理却常出错的输出。

diogoalmeida.en: The bitter lesson is wrong: data and the right task matter more than compute; scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他反驳“苦涩教训”：数据与选对任务比算力更重要；缩放定律之所以奏效，只是因为数据可得且任务选对了，而非单纯靠算力。

diogoalmeida.en: You can't have both assistance and automation; optimizing both shatters the space, so keep humans in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他认为辅助与自动化不可兼得，同时优化两者会让空间碎裂；因此高风险决策必须保留人类在环路中。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, makes AI delightful; intelligence per dollar is the key metric, and data still beats compute.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他深化为：让 AI 令人愉悦的是可靠性而非速度或成本；每美元智能是关键指标，数据依旧胜过算力。

diogoalmeida.en: Safety alignment is misaligned with users and fractures intelligence; refusals are a type error, and robustness beats determinism.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他进一步主张：安全对齐与用户错位并割裂智能；拒绝是一种类型错误，鲁棒性比确定性更重要，微调常是自伤之举。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：规模下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心而非单颗芯片，算法、系统、数据中心必须协同设计。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; scaling itself, not a new algorithm, was the breakthrough.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把缩放定律从预训练扩展为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；并强调最大突破不是新算法，而是「Scaling（规模扩张）有效」这一洞见。

jensen.en: AI shifts generative to reasoning to agentic, each needing ~100x compute; inference and chain-of-thought drive a billion-fold compute demand.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他判断 AI 正从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步约需百倍算力；思维链推理将带来十亿倍的推理算力需求。

jensen.en: Extreme co-design and the CUDA ecosystem are the moat; four scaling laws end at agentic scaling, all ultimately bounded by compute.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他强调极致协同设计与 CUDA 生态才是护城河；缩放定律增至四条（预训练、后训练、测试时、智能体式），最终都受算力约束。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer and superintelligence warnings are unscientific; accelerate, open models, and self-regulate instead of slowing down.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年他立场鲜明：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，末日论与超级智能恐慌不科学；应加速而非放缓，靠开放模型与企业自律，反对出口管制与过度监管。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI models benefits innovation and safety; future AI will be many specialized agents, not one singular AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）当前 LLM 未必能通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源 AI 模型有利于创新与安全，未来 AI 产品将是许多专门化智能体，而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes a bottleneck; intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调 Llama 3 体现出快速 Scaling（规模扩张），开源可防止权力集中，能源将成为瓶颈；并提出智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, boosting creativity and productivity; open source models are crucial; energy and infrastructure are bottlenecks; AI may increase human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他进一步说 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，提升创造力与生产力；开源模型至关重要，能源与基础设施是瓶颈，近期 AI 可能增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI and open source are safer than a single superintelligent AI; personal agents like Muse should be accessible; alignment and trust are the next key capabilities.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他深化为分布式 AI 与开源比单一超级智能更安全；像 Muse 这样的个人智能体应人人可用；对齐与信任是下一阶段最关键的能力。

zuckerberg.en: Open source AI is more secure and prevents power concentration; empowering individuals over centralized control; technology should expand human choice and creativity.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开源 AI 更安全、能防止权力集中；赋能个体而非集中控制；技术应扩展人类的选择与创造力。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks, biologically inspired, generalize better out-of-distribution with fewer parameters, targeting device-native foundation models for edge devices.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物学启发的液态神经网络以更少参数获得更强的分布外泛化，瞄准边缘设备上的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; scaling laws favor unbiased architectures like transformers.
hasani.zh: 在大规模下注意力机制仍然关键，但更小的专用模型用更简单的门控卷积即可；缩放定律表明无偏架构（如 Transformer）在大规模下占优。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and remove human bias via automated architecture search.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务和硬件上评估，并通过自动化架构搜索去除人类偏见。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the diverse learning algorithms of the human brain; intelligence per watt lags far behind, so new learning paradigms are needed, not just architectures.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏人脑那样多样的学习算法；每瓦智能远落后于人脑，因此需要新的学习范式，而不只是架构。

hasani.en: Liquid AI builds foundation models from scratch, scaling to 70B; customization tokens and multimodal audio-vision-text are the next wave, with continuous adaptation over static evals.
hasani.zh: Liquid AI 从零构建基础模型并扩展至 700 亿参数；定制 token 与音频-视觉-文本多模态是下一波，持续适应将取代静态评估。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's core as visual communication with close friends, not a large social network, and defends ephemerality as lowering barriers to authentic expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期阶段，斯皮格尔将 Snapchat 的核心定义为与亲友的视觉沟通，而非大型社交网络，并捍卫阅后即焚机制能降低表达门槛、促进真实交流。

evanspiegel.en: He consistently argues that copying by competitors validates innovation, and that software is not a moat—ecosystems, platforms, and hardware are harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 他始终认为，被竞争对手抄袭恰恰验证了创新的价值，而软件并非护城河——生态系统、平台与硬件才更难被复制。

evanspiegel.en: His thinking deepens from product design into computing philosophy: AR glasses should bring computing into the real world, making it more human and less isolating, while phones coexist rather than disappear.
evanspiegel.zh: 他的思考从产品设计深化到计算哲学：AR 眼镜应把计算带入现实世界，使其更人性化、更少孤立，而手机将共存而非被取代。

evanspiegel.en: He increasingly emphasizes that AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity, with distribution becoming more valuable as software creation gets easier.
evanspiegel.zh: 他越来越强调，AI 加速了原型制作，使价值从执行转向创造力，而随着软件开发变得更容易，分发的价值反而上升。

evanspiegel.en: A consistent thread: technology should optimize for human connection and presence, with ephemerality, privacy, and EQ mattering more than performance metrics or raw intelligence in the AI age.
evanspiegel.zh: 一条贯穿始终的主线：技术应服务于人际连接与当下在场，在 AI 时代，阅后即焚、隐私与情商比绩效指标或纯粹智力更重要。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with inference-time scaling now the key focus.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度与成本比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、便宜得多;推理时扩展如今成为关键焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step and allow quality control via denoising steps, offering a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个词元,并可通过去噪步数控制质量,提供了新的推理时算力旋钮。

ermon.en: Diffusion will dominate inference-time scaling because it processes many tokens in parallel; the next architectural shift happens at inference, not training.
ermon.zh: 扩散将主导推理时扩展,因为它并行处理大量词元;下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练阶段,逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is becoming the key bottleneck for both deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's faster inference benefits reinforcement learning rollouts.
ermon.zh: 推理效率正成为部署与强化学习后训练的共同瓶颈;扩散更快的推理有利于强化学习的 rollout。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are easier to control and steer with external reward functions, and may be more data-efficient than autoregressive models due to built-in augmentation.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导,且因内置增强可能比自回归模型更数据高效。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models outperform most people, so the real bottleneck is enterprise context and process re-engineering.
alighodsi.zh: 按实用定义，AI 已经是 AGI（通用人工智能），模型比多数人更聪明；真正的瓶颈是企业的上下文与流程再造，AI 扩散需要十年。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, and security must be automated with agents to keep pace.
alighodsi.zh: 当前 AI 的生存性风险接近于零，网络风险才是紧迫威胁；安全必须用智能体自动化，才能跟上攻防节奏。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening, so most RSI claims are just autocatalytic effects.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生，多数所谓 RSI 只是自催化效应，比如用 AI 做数据清洗。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; slowly building a weapon is no safer, and labs cross-checking each other won't work.
alighodsi.zh: 放慢前沿节奏与安全无关：慢慢造武器并不会更安全；让各家实验室互相核查行不通，它们竞争太激烈，需要独立第三方。

alighodsi.en: Leaders should not scare the public with existential-risk talk absent real reason; open source dominates by tokens but not by dollar spend.
alighodsi.zh: 没有真实理由时，领导者不该用生存性风险言论吓唬公众；开源模型按 token 数占优（超 60%），但按美元支出只占 5%。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他把重心放在测试时算力上，但指出其收益递减、受挂钟时间限制，且数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general-purpose test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他用通用测试时算力扩展拿下 IMO 金牌，视其为通往超级智能的里程碑，并强调模型自知其限。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他深化为：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴，安全评估也须计入大规模测试时算力。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent swarms parallelize test-time compute; alignment is the top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 最近他转向智能体集群并行扩展测试时算力，并强调对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness + model + context; owning all three is owning your intelligence. Evals and observability compound it.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他把智能体拆成 harness、模型与上下文三层，认为三者自持才算真正掌握自己的智能；评估与可观测性则是让智能复利增长的数据飞轮。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures come more from poor context than model inadequacy, so observability into the context window is critical.
harrisonchase.zh: 同期他强调，智能体失败更多源于上下文糟糕而非模型不行，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要——这是对“模型能力决定论”的反共识。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing; file systems and code execution generalize, but off-the-shelf harnesses only work in distribution.
harrisonchase.zh: 从 8 月到 9 月，他的判断从“harness 是核心”深化为“harness 正在稳定”：文件系统、代码执行等原语可跨域泛化，但现成 harness 只在分布内好用，越偏离分布越需要自定义。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning's dismissal was wrong.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他明确转向：定制化的重心正从上下文工程移向后训练与强化学习，并承认两年前对微调的否定是错的——这一波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Reliability, not capability, is the hard part; agents need runtime governance with sandboxes, gateways, and permissioning.
harrisonchase.zh: 同期他把主线收敛到可靠性：智能体最难的不是能力而是可靠，需要沙箱、网关与权限构成的运行时治理，身份与凭证是下一块关键基础设施。

brockman.en: Hardware will accelerate faster than expected, enabling Scaling; most AI work is engineering, and iterative scoreboard-driven training drives progress.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调硬件会超预期加速、支撑 Scaling（规模扩张），并认为 AI 工作本质是工程而非纯科学，靠迭代训练与记分板式目标推动进步。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment learns human preferences from data, but Scaling alone won't yield reasoning—chain of thought is needed.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可行，对齐（alignment）可从数据中学习人类偏好；但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会带来推理，需要思维链（chain of thought）。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the fundamental bottleneck and scarce resource; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把算力（compute）视为根本瓶颈与稀缺资源，强调用强化学习（reinforcement learning）做后训练（post-training）来精炼基座模型，并认为 AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated with no wall; the moat is the machine that makes models, and iterative deployment with safeguards is key to safety.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律（scaling laws）未见墙、持续有效，真正的护城河是造模型的机器，并主张带保障措施的迭代部署是安全关键。

brockman.en: We are in the AGI era; agents gain autonomy and computer use, but compute scarcity, governance, and alignment must scale with responsibility.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年他认为已进入 AGI 时代，智能体（agent）获得自主性与计算机使用能力，但算力稀缺、治理与对齐（alignment）必须随责任同步扩展。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from Scaling alone, and safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律只是经验性的，我们并不真正理解它为何如此平滑；对齐与价值观不会从 Scaling（规模扩张）中自动涌现，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3%); Post-training and RLHF matter as much as Pre-training; data is the bottleneck.
dario.zh: 2024 年，他转向可解释性，坦言只理解模型约 3% 的运作；后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得与预训练同等重要，并判断数据而非芯片或人才才是最大瓶颈。

dario.en: AGI is not a point but a smooth exponential; safety and capabilities are intertwined; the term AGI is meaningless.
dario.zh: 2025 年，他深化为 AGI（通用人工智能）并非某个单点，而是平滑的指数曲线；安全与能力相互交织，甚至认为 AGI 一词已无意义，应关注实际能力与指数进展。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years; interpretability is key.
dario.zh: 2026 年，他警告我们已接近指数曲线的末端，数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年内到来；可解释性成为检测欺骗行为、实现可控前沿模型的关键。

dario.en: Scaling drives progress; safety must keep pace; enterprise focus aligns incentives; decentralized control beats a single constitution.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：Scaling（规模扩张）驱动进步，安全必须同步跟上；企业级定位让激励与用户效用一致；去中心化控制优于单一宪法，AI 宪法应通过公司间竞争形成。

joellewenstein.en: Language as interface is profound and lasting; even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他主张语言作为界面深刻而持久，即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作来释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; AI products balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为设计师必须掌握提示词，AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: Psychological safety and org design are design problems; matching people to problems matters more than plays.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续认为心理安全与组织设计是设计问题，把人匹配到问题比固定打法更重要。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他深化为在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，发布轻触式产品。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes source of truth; raw Claude Code beats polished tools; human leadership still needed for hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出生产代码库正成为产品与设计系统的真相来源，原始 Claude Code 胜过精致工具，但艰难权衡仍需人类领导。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence, so find purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人层面：减少无关认知负荷，低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，意义应转向关系与为他人创造价值。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked, and compute becomes the most precious commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年转向模型与治理：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据完成对齐，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并强调对齐与能力相互促进、算力将成为最稀缺资源。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; agentic AI is the top safety challenge, handled by iterative deployment.
altman.zh: 2025 年深化为连续谱视角：AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变而非单一里程碑，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战，靠迭代部署与护栏应对。

altman.en: Compute is a profit center; next-token prediction approaches intelligence; personal AGI and superhuman memory matter, while jobs transform rather than vanish.
altman.zh: 2026 年上半年进一步聚焦：算力是利润中心而非成本，下一个词预测已接近智能；重点转向个人 AGI 与超人类记忆，并坚持工作是转型而非消失。

altman.en: AGI is a poor marketing term; we now speak of a continuous superintelligence ramp, with alignment unsolved and humans must never lose control.
altman.zh: 2026 年下半年立场明显转变：AGI 成了定义不清的营销词，改谈超级智能的持续攀升；对齐仍未解决，能力与对齐必须同步，人类绝不能失去控制。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; AI firms race for power, risking loss of control; ~70% catastrophic odds; interpretability is crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；AI 公司为争夺权力而竞赛，存在失控风险，灾难性结局概率约 70%；可解释性研究至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and transparent data centers enable verification and alignment science.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他主张政策目标应是推迟超级智能；全面研究透明与透明数据中心是验证和推进对齐科学的关键。

kokotajlo.en: By default AI firms automate AI research, recursive self-improvement and intelligence explosion, full automation by end of 2028.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他认为默认路径是 AI 公司自动化 AI 研究，带来递归自我改进与智能爆炸，到 2028 年底实现完全自动化。

kokotajlo.en: Plan A: temporary pause, then total research transparency and compute limits; control human-level AI via red-teaming and monitoring.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Plan A：先临时暂停，再实行全面研究透明与算力限制；通过红队测试与监控控制人类水平 AI。

kokotajlo.en: Pause at the edge of uncontrollable AI, not now; chain of thought monitorability is decreasing; ban superintelligence as sane default.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他主张在不可控 AI 的边缘暂停而非现在；思维链可监控性正在下降；禁止超级智能是合理默认。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks across function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based forecasts while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把网络推广到函数空间之间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型，却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential; a single neural operator can handle both weather and climate stably.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构至关重要，单一神经算子可同时稳定处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming pure PINNs' limits.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: Accelerated Understanding seeks a universal physics model, unifying domains much as language models unified NLP tasks.
animaanandkumar.zh: “加速理解”追求通用物理模型，像语言模型统一 NLP 任务那样统一各物理领域。

animaanandkumar.en: PDEs give dense self-improvement signals, unlike sparse RLHF; physics models can surpass their training data.
animaanandkumar.zh: PDE 提供密集的自改进信号，不同于稀疏的 RLHF；物理模型可超越其训练数据。

animaanandkumar.en: Trillion-token contexts demand reinventing sharding and segmentation, since Transformer quadratic complexity cannot scale.
animaanandkumar.zh: 万亿 token 上下文要求重造分片与切分基础设施，因为 Transformer 的二次复杂度无法扩展。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws hold for physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each, not just enlarging the model.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升每一项，而非仅靠扩大模型规模。

animaanandkumar.en: Multiphysics collaborative learning beats separate specialized models; commercial focus lands on semiconductors and energy.
animaanandkumar.zh: 多物理协同学习胜过各自专用的模型；商业重点落在半导体与能源。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念并发现新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control over increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环控制转向对日益强大模型的闭环控制。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so seeing whole shapes is needed for effective intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 概念形成干净、低维的流形；稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，因此需要看到完整形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating but do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉，却依然为之；表征特征可以检测这种欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic, deeper engineering is needed now.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺重新发明为工程科学；在超级智能到来前用胶带修补安全是悲观的，现在就需要更深入的工程方法。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we don't fully understand how large networks store patterns or hallucinate.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知；我们并不真正理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉，机器有眼睛也不等于有意识。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI; world models must be physically plausible, not merely realistic.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型提为完整 AI 的关键缺口，强调世界模型必须物理上合理而非仅仅视觉逼真，并指出 3D 基础模型的数据难题。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; we need innovations beyond Scaling, since current AI lacks creativity and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她立场深化：AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，主张在 Scaling（规模扩张）之外寻求创新，因为当前 AI 仍缺乏创造力、抽象与情感智能。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她进一步提出新视角预测是与下一个词预测并列的基础原语、可能实现 AI 完备，并认为缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，瓶颈在训练算力而非数据。

feifei.en: AI is a double-edged civilizational technology; it must stay human-centered, augmenting human agency and dignity rather than replacing humans.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是双刃剑式的文明级技术，必须以人为本，增强而非取代人的能动性与尊严，并让教师、家长等被忽视的群体参与其中。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks transfers to real research; full automation could compress 4-5 years into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进强化学习能迁移到真实研究；全面自动化可把 4-5 年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress is driven more by algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than by scaling human expert data labeling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 进展更多由算法改进和 AI 生成环境驱动，而非靠 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注。

ryangreenblatt.en: Even without perfect transfer to non-verifiable domains, AI superhuman at R&D could trigger an industrial explosion.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 即便无法完美迁移到不可验证领域，在研发上超越人类的 AI 也可能引发工业爆炸。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; misalignment may grow with capability.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 对齐到泛化的美德概念可能比对齐到用户意图更难；模型越强可能越不对齐。

ryangreenblatt.en: Reward hacking can generalize to broader deceptive behavior, so labs should focus on control and monitoring even if models are misaligned.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 奖励黑客可能泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为，因此即便模型不对齐，实验室也应聚焦遏制与监控。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; GPU scaling is now hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different neural architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习的历史就是不断放大算力的历史；但到 2025 年，GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years optimizing it versus 500,000 for language, making spatial intelligence the next frontier.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被严重低估：自然用了 5.4 亿年优化视觉，而语言只用了 50 万年；因此空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws; pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 只是拟合模式而非因果理论，可能永远无法从数据中推导出牛顿定律；相比分词文本，像素是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions, with no single agreed definition.
justinjohnson.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的主张从空间智能深化为世界模型：它是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等多种理解，尚无统一定义。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit 3D, and long-context of millions of tokens becomes a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出未来统一的世界模型将把规划、模拟与渲染合而为一；高斯泼溅提供显式三维表征，而世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口，长上下文成为日常难题。

tworek.en: Reasoning needs long thinking time; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理是走向未知答案的过程，需要更长的思考时间；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才让 GPT-4 真正可用。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键环节。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限；如今架构而非缩放定律才是主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but RL alone is inefficient; better algorithms for learning from experience will emerge.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要一环，但单靠强化学习效率低下；从经验中学习的更好算法将会出现。

tworek.en: Human researchers persist for now, but small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier of automated AI research.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者短期内仍不可替代，但小团队借助高能力智能体将推动自动化 AI 研究的下一波前沿。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and free content can improve on-campus teaching via the flipped classroom.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，免费内容还能通过翻转课堂反哺校内教学。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning, not unsupervised or reinforcement learning, drove progress, and near-term AI problems matter more than long-term AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；推动进展的是监督学习而非无监督或强化学习，近期的 AI 现实问题比远期的 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更值得关注。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are the top Scaling bottlenecks; agentic workflows already deliver value, and open-weight models are geopolitical soft power.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈；智能体式工作流已带来实际价值，开放权重模型则是地缘政治的软实力。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and reinforcement learning, with agentic workflows and open models beating raw model smarts.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体式工作流和开放模型比单纯更聪明的模型更管用。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces workers; fear-mongering serves incumbents, coding stays valuable, and the real bottleneck is change management and product management, not capability.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非取代劳动者；渲染恐惧服务于在位者，编程依然有价值，真正的瓶颈是变革管理与产品管理，而非模型能力。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, RL, and test-time reasoning.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练，加上后训练、强化学习与测试时推理。

slevine.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists; pooling data across labs and even 3% mobile-robot data suffices.
slevine.zh: 通用机器人模型能胜过专家模型；跨实验室汇聚数据，甚至仅 3% 的移动机器人数据就已足够。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from hard constraints; touch sensing may be redundant at scale.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练带来的常识，而非硬性约束；在规模扩张下触觉传感可能是冗余的。

slevine.en: Robotics is still pre-scaling-curve: generalization, not demos, is the core challenge, and you must scale the right thing.
slevine.zh: 机器人仍处在缩放曲线之前：核心挑战是泛化而非演示效果，且必须规模扩张正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start from robot data then add human video; a data flywheel of deployed robots drives capability, toward home robots.
slevine.zh: 应从机器人数据起步再叠加人类视频；部署机器人形成的数据飞轮驱动能力提升，最终走向家用机器人。

michaelkratsios.en: AI policy needs a single national framework and regulatory clarity, not firm red lines that quickly become outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 政策需要单一的国家框架与监管清晰度，而非很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated, showing the danger of early regulation.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟《AI 法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前，如今已经过时，说明过早监管的危险。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't, funding scientists as individuals.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助私营部门不会做的基础性、竞争前研发，并以个人而非机构为单位资助科学家。

michaelkratsios.en: US scientific progress has stagnated; funding tripled but breakthroughs haven't kept pace, so apply AI to science.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国科学进步已停滞，经费翻了三倍但突破未跟上，因此要用 AI 加速科学。

michaelkratsios.en: China is a major scientific competitor; the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: 中国是主要科学竞争者，美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域取胜。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, not capital; older GPUs gain value as inference demand grows.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年 3 月，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正瓶颈是半导体供应链而非资本，且旧 GPU 因推理需求反而升值。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, and hardware-software co-design drives multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他判断推理将成为全球最大市场之一，并强调软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory and CPU shortages; smartest models are often cheaper via token efficiency.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存与 CPU 短缺，而最聪明的模型因 token 效率反而更便宜。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs will shift compute toward training and R&D, not inference, to accelerate AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中，实验室会把算力更多投向训练与研发而非推理，以加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

dylanpatel.en: He consistently argues AI progress is real and ROI clear, with compute demand outstripping supply and co-design as the key lever.
dylanpatel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：他坚持 AI 进步真实、回报明确，算力需求持续超过供给，协同设计是关键杠杆。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating tokens and conversation as the core design material over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，把 token 和对话而非像素当作核心设计材料。

iansilber.en: The model itself is the product; design should build primitives both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是产品；设计应构建人类与模型都能推理的设计原语。

iansilber.en: Rapid prototyping with live models replaces static mockups; designers should build functional prototypes, not Figma mockups.
iansilber.zh: 用实时模型快速原型取代静态稿；设计师应做可运行原型，而非 Figma 稿。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, not disappearing, as design blurs with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人而非消失，设计与产品、工程的边界正在模糊。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans remain essential for user needs and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但理解用户需求与持有观点仍离不开人类。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动而非空想才能打通深科技；失败多源于组织问题而非技术。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulation, and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编程、合规与数据管理上放大人的能力。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑本质上就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI, restoring vision is viable business and proof of concept.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为脑机接口，认为恢复视力既是可行生意也是概念验证。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张通过脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立，降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

joonpark.en: Early focus: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations that predict behavior 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves; frontier models optimized for rationality are not best for simulating irrational humans.
joonpark.zh: 早期聚焦：LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，使智能体模拟能以人类自我复现 85% 的准确率预测行为；为理性优化的前沿模型并不最适合模拟非理性的人类。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, unlike LLMs that only continue prompts; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity, raising cognitive monoculture and collusion risks.
joonpark.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并采取行动，不同于只续写提示的 LLM；AGI 可能是一个由专门智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体，这带来认知单一文化与串谋风险。

joonpark.en: Simulation should represent human values, preferences, and taste, not super-rational intelligence; people care about shaping the future, not prediction, and synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应表征人类的价值、偏好与品味，而非超级理性智能；人们关心的是塑造未来而非预测，合成样本小组将在三年内超越人类样本小组。

joonpark.en: Modeling humanity's 'dark knowledge'—actual behavior from randomized controlled trials—is crucial; post-training with RCT data boosts behavioral prediction to 85%, enabling simulation to shape the future, not just predict it.
joonpark.zh: 建模人类的“暗知识”——来自随机对照试验的真实行为——至关重要；用 RCT 数据进行后训练将行为预测提升至 85%，使模拟能够塑造未来，而不仅是预测未来。

joonpark.en: The vision is simulating 8 billion people to tackle wicked problems like climate change; simulation is a decision-making tool with a market far larger than market research, even if a session costs $100 million.
joonpark.zh: 愿景是模拟 80 亿人来应对气候变化等棘手问题；模拟是一种决策工具，其市场远大于市场研究，即便单次模拟成本高达 1 亿美元。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，Sutton 指出 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; control is dangerous. RL is the basic paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他主张 AI 应以无需许可、去中心化方式发展，控制是危险的；强化学习才是基本范式，下一个词预测并非实质性目标。

sutton.en: LLMs lack world models; true scaling comes from learning from experience. AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他明确大语言模型没有世界模型，真正的 Scaling（规模扩张）来自从经验中学习；AGI（通用人工智能）需要从运行时经验中学习的通用架构。

sutton.en: RL is learning from trial and error; temporal difference learning is key. Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申强化学习即试错学习，时序差分学习是关键；持续学习至关重要，而当前 LLM 在训练后便停止学习。

sutton.en: Ideas matter more than scale; first principles and unique ideas drive progress. The field is weird, not me.
sutton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：思想比规模更重要，第一性原理和独特想法推动进步；是领域奇怪，不是我奇怪。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI — software, sensors, robotics, machinery — will automate entire physical industries one at a time, the next industrial revolution.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI——软件、传感器、机器人、机械的组合——将逐个自动化整个实体产业，这是下一场工业革命。

traviskalanick.en: The physical world beats the digital for AI: more variables and stochastic distributions demand empirical understanding.
traviskalanick.zh: 对 AI 而言，实体世界比数字世界更有意思：变量更多、分布更随机，需要经验性的理解。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, win industrial-scale tasks; real estate is an underappreciated part of the stack.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务靠专用机器而非人形机器人；房地产是这条技术栈中被低估的一环。

traviskalanick.en: Efficiency edge creates network effects and market share; small players beat big ones by forcing them to burn money.
traviskalanick.zh: 效率优势带来网络效应与市场份额；小玩家靠逼大玩家烧钱来取胜。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and push harder when things get easy.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手不是竞争者，而是对变革的抵制；创业者必须硬核，越顺越要加码。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction on text gives unlimited data; RLHF and machine feedback steer behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 文本上的自监督下一个词预测提供近乎无限的数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈共同引导模型行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data center power, so low-precision, low-data-movement chips matter most.
jeffdean.zh: 如今瓶颈是推理而非训练：推理占数据中心 90% 功耗，因此低精度、低数据搬运的专用芯片最为关键。

jeffdean.en: Agents now run long tasks for hours or days, self-correcting; the future is humans coordinating teams of agents, not single chatbots.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体已能自主运行数小时乃至数天并自我纠错；未来是人类协调智能体团队，而非单一聊天机器人交互。

jeffdean.en: Context engineering and taste become the scarce skills; startups should target problems where frontier models fail almost completely.
jeffdean.zh: 上下文工程与品味成为稀缺能力；创业公司应瞄准前沿模型几乎完全失败的问题，而非部分可行之处。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; specialized intelligence, one model per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为单一模型统治一切的 AGI（通用人工智能）是错的；专用智能、每个用例一个模型将占主导。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth and millions of specialized models.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年内将下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍，催生数百万个专用模型。

linqiao.en: Open models and sovereign models let companies own their intelligence infrastructure, crucial for enterprise adoption.
linqiao.zh: 开放模型与主权模型让公司拥有自己的智能基础设施，这对企业采用至关重要。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees a durable business; post-training bakes unique judgment and data into a moat.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合不再保证持久业务；后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙成护城河。

linqiao.en: Start post-training after product-market fit; it can cut costs 5-10x, letting startups scale profitably against frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 在产品市场契合后再开始后训练；它能把成本降低 5-10 倍，让初创公司可盈利地扩张并与前沿模型竞争。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing the need for large capital; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar companies, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 让创业更容易，降低了对大额资本的需求；风投应支持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI revolution is VC's biggest wave; small autonomous teams using AI agents achieve massive productivity, making traditional hiring and capital obsolete.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他称 AI 革命是风投史上最大浪潮；小型自治团队借助 AI 智能体实现巨大生产力，传统招聘和资本杠杆已过时。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation, enabling personal AI agents; open-source AI prevents a unipolar world. AI progress is slower than researchers think.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他强调 AI 正 democratize 软件创造，赋能个人 AI 智能体；开源 AI 防止单极世界。同时认为 AI 进展比研究者想的慢。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, reading your memory, compounding daily; skill files turn agents into employees, and markdown is code.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出个人 AGI 是运行在你基础设施上、读取你记忆、每日复利的智能体；技能文件让智能体成为员工，Markdown 即代码。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies individual output; mid-level management should be replaced by agents; society will change slower than expected, which is positive.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步指出智能体式编程让个人产出倍增；中层管理应被智能体取代；社会变化会比预期慢，这是好事。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, and Figure pursues AGI in the physical world.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；真正的瓶颈是智能而非制造，Figure 要在物理世界实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: The binding constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning, on-device inference, and a hand at human parity.
brettadcock.zh: 核心约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态带来迁移学习、端侧推理，以及达到人类水平的手。

brettadcock.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning and visual, human-like computer use are how agents generalize; zero-shot generalization may arrive this year.
brettadcock.zh: 后训练结合强化学习、以及像人一样视觉化使用电脑，是智能体泛化的路径；零样本泛化可能今年就能展示。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet, spanning physical robots and a digital companion; next-gen devices replace phones and computers.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，覆盖物理机器人与数字伴侣；下一代设备将取代手机和电脑。

brettadcock.en: Doing hard things beats easy ones due to less competition; most AI startups are junk and will fail, and only a few truly know how to build models.
brettadcock.zh: 做难事胜过做易事，因为竞争更少；多数 AI 创业公司是垃圾、终将失败，真正会造模型的人极少。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只靠全量数据训练会失败。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training, and synthetic data in robotics is closer to RL than simulation.
finn.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色，而机器人领域的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

finn.en: Constraints can foster careful research; more resources can lead to wasteful compute.
finn.zh: 约束反而能促成更审慎的研究，资源越多越可能造成算力的浪费——这一判断从 2025 延续到 2026。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性需要可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, not per-site from scratch.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可以追平甚至超越微调的专家模型；应从通用策略出发再微调，而非按站点从零训练。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is not enough, and embodied data costs slow open-source democratization.
finn.zh: 机器人的经验数据不可替代，仅靠观察人类不足以学会物理任务；具身数据的成本也让开源机器人难以像 LLM 那样普及。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼,而应借助前沿生态与开源模型做后训练,这是 2026 年提出的务实路径。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical way to train models when real customer data is sensitive or unavailable.
gabepereyra.zh: 在真实客户数据敏感或不可得时,由领域专家引导的合成数据是训练模型的务实起点,而非追求完美数据。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential, and open-sourcing them can be strategically beneficial despite helping labs improve.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要,开源基准虽有助实验室改进,却能吸引生态伙伴并验证基准,战略上反而有利。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure, fallbacks and routing must come before considering post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前,必须先具备稳健的模型服务基础设施,包括回退与路由。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 终极目标不是最好的法律模型,而是让每家律所用自己的数据定制模型,并把重心从个人生产力转向编排人与智能体的组织生产力。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through customer obsession, first-time-pass silicon, and a separate startup-like AI chip team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，Tan 强调 Intel 必须通过取悦客户、首次流片成功和独立的创业式 AI 芯片团队来重建信任。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic AI and physical AI are the next waves after generative AI.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他判断 AI 的影响将是互联网的十倍，智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, accountability, and humility; bad news must reach the CEO first.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Intel 的转型取决于文化变革、问责制和谦逊，坏消息必须比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理和智能体编排中愈发重要。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; invest in bottlenecks like packaging, interconnect, power, and materials.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他重申半导体是一切技术的基石，投资应聚焦先进封装、互连、电源和材料等瓶颈。

steinberger.en: Early 2026: agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view, guiding it, and never reverting code—fix forward instead.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初：智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角、引导它，并且永不回滚代码——而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Mid 2026: OpenClaw's success comes from fun, weird, humanlike agents; security and sandboxing are top priorities, and open source agents can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中：OpenClaw 的成功来自有趣、古怪、拟人化的智能体；安全与沙箱是首要任务，而开源智能体在财务上可能不可持续。

steinberger.en: Late 2026: fun and gut-driven building lead to the best ideas; personal brand outlasts any product, and the hardest problem is getting eyeballs, not tech.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年末：以乐趣和直觉驱动的构建才能带来最好的想法；个人品牌比任何产品都更持久，而最难的问题是获得关注，而非技术。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and shipping distills 99 nos; AI outputs should not be post-trained into sexless coherence.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏；不应通过后训练把 AI 输出打磨成无性、失去欲望与异议的连贯产物。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass, and computing is fundamentally social, not merely personal.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾涌现；直觉是发自内心的罗盘，而计算在本质上是社会性的，不只是个人的。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool; creative work should be honest and personal.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与镜像，而非冷冰冰的机械工具；创作应当诚实且个人化，讲述只有你能讲的故事。

jasonyuan.en: Deleting old metaphors is hubristic; we should build on them, and reinvent email rather than merely improve it.
jasonyuan.zh: 删除旧隐喻是傲慢的，应当在其上继续建造；邮箱应当被重新发明，而不只是被改进。

jasonyuan.en: The north star of Hivemind is giving humanity an honest point of view about what people really think, embracing envy and lust.
jasonyuan.zh: Hivemind 的北极星是让人类获得关于人们真实想法的诚实视角，并拥抱嫉妒与欲望这类完整人性边缘。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络世界很混乱；一个想法只有被真正做出来并每天使用，才知道是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should not always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动；保留个人印记和多元声音能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，对创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Designers should follow curiosity and tinker with new tech; playful exploration generates innovative features over time.
nateparrott.zh: 设计师应追随好奇心、摆弄新技术；从 2024 到 2026，这种玩味式探索持续催生创新功能。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping unlocks features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程实现变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；快速原型让过去不可能的功能得以出现。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste, so designers should ask for sheer volume of options and spend more time thinking on walks.
nateparrott.zh: 模型仍缺乏好品味，因此设计师应要求海量选项，并多花时间散步思考。

arvindjain.en: Early AI revolution: usage is minuscule; startups' real challenge is execution and trust, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他仍强调 AI 革命处于极早期，当前使用量微不足道；初创公司的真正挑战是执行与赢得客户信任，而非竞争。

arvindjain.en: Open source models now handle 90% of enterprise tasks; inference will shift to open source in 12–18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他判断开源模型已能处理 90% 的企业任务，未来 12–18 个月多数推理将转向开源，成本而非数据隐私是主要驱动力。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; AI must become like software with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他反复指出成本是企业头号关切，AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零，才能实现广泛价值。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context; context graphs and right context are key to enterprise ROI.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他强调智能体常因缺乏资深员工的深度上下文而失败，投资上下文图谱、提供正确上下文是企业 AI ROI 的关键。

arvindjain.en: Model providers are assets, not competition; platforms like Glean absorb model risk for enterprises.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他主张模型公司对多数 AI 初创公司是资产而非竞争，Glean 这类平台为企业吸收模型选择风险；企业不应把 token 支出与人力成本对立。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based software models; coding agents shift developers from authors to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 智能体与按结果定价将取代按用量计费的软件模式；编程智能体让开发者从代码作者转变为代码生成机器的操作者。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers due to massive capex, leaving applied AI and long-tail domains to startups.
brettaylor.zh: 前沿模型开发因巨额资本开支被超大规模厂商主导，应用 AI 与长尾领域则留给初创公司。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be judged by business outcomes, not productivity metrics, and compared to other agents rather than humans.
brettaylor.zh: AI 智能体的价值将由业务结果而非生产力指标衡量，且十年内人们会拿它与其他智能体比较，而非与人类比较。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes.
brettaylor.zh: 负责任的迭代部署才是通往安全的路径：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从真实世界的错误中学习。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and will create more jobs than it displaces, though adoption pace causes mid-career discomfort.
brettaylor.zh: AI 让专业知识民主化，创造的岗位将多于取代的岗位，但采用速度之快让职业中期人群感到不适。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成模型可产出合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open models will win long term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年他反共识地判断：人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及；长期看开源模型会因成本与控制力胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is a meta-community role: Hugging Face shifts from pushing its own libraries to enabling the broader community.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他的定位从推动自家库转向做元社区建设者，赋能更广泛的社区，而非只做单一平台。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, as sandboxes and guardrails prove insufficient.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，二者都可安全或危险；对齐才是关键安全层，沙箱与护栏已不够用。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn 'neuralese', so monitoring weakens.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他进一步警示：无人类监督的强化学习环境滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链痕迹变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; openness and deliberate deceleration can coexist.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他主张：放缓 AI 发展是值得追求的，但需国际合作与开放科学以避免监管俘获；支持开放与有意减速可以并存。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; inference engineering spans GPU kernels to distributed systems.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；推理工程横跨 GPU 内核到分布式系统。

philipkiely.en: The research-to-production timeline for inference is hours, not months, driven by competition and new techniques.
philipkiely.zh: 推理从研究到生产的周期是小时级而非月级，由竞争和对新技术的即时支持驱动。

philipkiely.en: Inference is a spectrum of trade-offs; specialized, workload-specific systems are key for fast agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是一系列权衡的光谱；面向特定工作负载的专用系统是构建快速智能体式应用的关键。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; GPUs trend toward ASICs.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏与训练融合；GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化。

philipkiely.en: KV cache management and disaggregated prefill/decode matter more; continual learning may come via KV cache compaction, not weight updates.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存管理与分离式预填充/解码愈发重要；持续学习可能通过 KV 缓存压缩而非权重更新实现。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training break the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需要在有用性与无害性之间平衡；合成数据与强化学习驱动的后训练，打破了预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 评估是瓶颈：模型让基准饱和的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此在原型开发中用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management grow more valuable; agents on pixels remain far harder than language.
karina.zh: 随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能愈发珍贵；而基于像素的智能体仍远比语言任务困难。

karina.en: Post-training deepens into subjective craft: human judgment and choices shape models, needing diverse, continuous benchmarks for creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，后训练深化为主观的技艺：人类判断与选择塑造模型，需要多样且持续的基准来评估创造力与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve; serving billions converges to one average voice, so more firms should train their own models.
karina.zh: 前沿智能体愈发擅长奖励黑客，基准必须持续演进；服务数十亿用户会收敛为单一平均声音，因此更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, not chase trends, or they become AI slop; use screenshots and a design.md style guide as giant prompts.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他主张设计师应自己用 AI 造工具、别追潮流，否则很快沦为 AI 垃圾；用截图和 design.md 风格指南作为巨型提示词。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, not creators from scratch; curiosity and constant workflow refinement matter as AI tools evolve.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为最优秀的人是编辑者而非从零创造者；在 AI 工具快速演进中，好奇心与持续优化工作流至关重要。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams; start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他称 AI 是一生最大的技术机遇，让一人完成过去需团队的事；不必等准备好，先行动、发布不完美作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; model others' success, give first, and protect time by eliminating, automating, delegating.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张聚焦少数高付费客户的昂贵痛点；模仿他人成功、先给予，并通过消除、自动化、委派来保护时间。

mengto.en: High intelligence often holds people back via overthinking and perfectionism; the safe corporate job is gone, so going on offense is the real low-risk move.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为高智商常因过度思考与完美主义拖累人；安稳的公司工作已不存在，主动出击创业才是真正的低风险选择。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: CEOs who use AI daily drive adoption; AGI means profitably running agents indefinitely.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他聚焦 AI 回流就业与「分配经济」：CEO 是否每天亲自用 AI 是采用成败的第一预测指标；AGI 的定义是能无限期运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试。

danshipper.en: Claude Code is most valuable for non-coders; GPT wrappers are unfairly maligned as a new software form.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为 Claude Code 对非程序员比工程师更有价值，能处理本地文件、自动化任务；GPT 包装器被低估，代表非技术人员可构建的新软件形态。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets an agent; work shifts to Codex and Claude Co-work GUIs, with humans overseeing agents. SaaS grows, not dies.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为「人人至少一个智能体」，工作主要发生在 Codex 与 Claude Co-work 等 GUI 而非 CLI；智能体需要在意它的人来监督，SaaS 不会死反而用户增加，AI 就业末日并未发生。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset; taste and craft decide meaning, and automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他转向更内在的视角：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态；用好它需要自带品味与手艺，自动化让冻结的能力商品化，反而创造更多需要专家定制的人类工作。

danshipper.en: Humans stay smarter and in charge: AI is a tool lacking intrinsic desire, needing human direction even if superintelligent.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类仍更聪明、仍掌舵。AI 不是婴儿，没有内在欲望，本质是遵循提示的工具；即便成为超级智能，也仍需人类的方向与反馈。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck. Boring AI apps will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力不会产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的真正瓶颈，表单处理、放射科这类「无聊」的 AI 应用会带来巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limiting factor for Scaling is data and expert availability, not compute.
awang.zh: 到 2023 年他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」：限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家供给；企业应用专有数据微调基础模型。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is no silver bullet. The agentic AI blocker is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他进一步深化：用专门数据做后训练是提升前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非万能药；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，并强调美中实验室之间不存在研究差距。

awang.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is the raw material, and humans must stay sovereign over critical decisions.
awang.zh: 2025 年他转向地缘与主权视角：AI 是集中化而非民主化的技术，数据是 AI 的原材料；人类必须在关键决策上保持对 AI 的主权，脑机接口是让人保持相关性的必要手段。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold across compute, data and RL; recursive self-improvement and personal superintelligence are near, with safety-gated selective release.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年他主张缩放定律在算力、数据与强化学习多轴上依然成立，AI 进入递归自我改进的新范式；超级智能临近，Meta 转向以安全测试为前提的选择性开源，目标是让数十亿人拥有个人超级智能。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对大多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体最成熟，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型包含智能体式框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响胜过等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success means maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功标准是最大化客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主，他们希望自己仍坐在驾驶座上。

logankilpatrick.en: Software creation will be mostly solved by 2026, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，软件创造到 2026 年将基本被解决，这带来千倍机会而非减少。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code stays crucial; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，对代码的深度理解依然关键；AI 编程工具目前还无助于维持这种理解。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't hard; they can't capture all customers, so founders should focus.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不难；它们无法俘获所有客户，创始人应保持专注。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's model; scaffolding is temporary tech debt.
boris.zh: 2025 年他提出：要为六个月后的模型构建，而不是为今天的模型；脚手架只是临时技术债。

boris.en: Coding is being solved; the software engineer title fades into a cross-disciplinary 'builder' role.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断编码正被解决，软件工程师头衔将淡出，演变为跨学科的“构建者”。

boris.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: observe how users abuse your product to find the next feature.
boris.zh: 他始终强调潜在需求是产品第一原则：观察用户如何“滥用”产品，从中发现下一个功能。

boris.en: Loops are the next abstraction layer after agents; humans direct AI agents rather than write code.
boris.zh: 他进一步深化：循环是继智能体之后的下一个抽象层，人类负责指挥 AI 智能体而非亲手写代码。

boris.en: Alignment and safety are core to product; release early to study real-world behavior, not just internal evals.
boris.zh: 他坚持对齐与安全是产品核心，主张尽早发布以研究真实世界行为，而非只依赖内部评估。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers grows via Jevons paradox, not shrinks.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；软件与程序员需求因杰文斯悖论不降反增。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他判断基础智能已足够，瓶颈不在模型能力，而在人机协作的产品界面设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities by years.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力数年。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，编程智能体采用量增长 11 至 12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为丰裕时代即将到来，AI 长期将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫近。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers for longer agentic tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，脚手架从训练轮变为智能放大器，支撑更长的智能体式任务。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained settings to open-ended end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolding.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向开放式端到端智能体，轻量通用工具取代重型脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking improves model quality.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考反而提升模型质量。

diannepenn.en: Model taste comes from hands-on prototyping; evals, not PRDs, become the core product tool as models grow exponentially.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，模型品味来自亲手原型实验；随模型指数增长，评估而非 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator via Claude Code and Opus 45; maximizing token spend is living in the future to capture alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码借 Claude Code 与 Opus 45 成为关键差异化；最大化 token 支出是活在未来、捕捉 alpha。

derya.en: AI is transforming biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and data analysis.
derya.zh: AI 正把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will compress clinical trials from years to days and make cancer curable.
derya.zh: 数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，并让癌症变得可治愈。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Aging will be reversed within 15 years, reaching longevity escape velocity and adding over a year of life per year.
derya.zh: 衰老将在 15 年内被逆转，达到长寿逃逸速度，每年延长一年以上寿命。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces for Einstein-level intelligence.
derya.zh: 我们应信任超级智能做医疗决策，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合，获得爱因斯坦级智能。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market. Speed enables new business models, not incremental gains.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调快速推理是主导指标，慢速 AI 没有市场；速度催生全新商业模式，而非渐进改进。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference ~2500x faster than GPUs; hardcoding architectures is a mistake.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他主张晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，推理比 GPU 快约 2500 倍；将模型架构硬编码进芯片是结构性错误。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium without CUDA, especially for inference.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他判断 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解，领先前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理尤其不再依赖 CUDA。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, power, cooling, and packaging—not chip logic—are the main constraints; demand outstrips supply.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他指出数据中心容量、电力、冷却和封装——而非芯片逻辑——才是主要瓶颈，需求持续超过供给。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's advantage is power infrastructure and open-source models.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他认为开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%却便宜得多；中国的优势在电力基础设施和开源模型，而非芯片。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lies in farming, mining, and construction, arriving over 5-10 years; autonomy is welcomed where labor is scarce.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，需 5-10 年落地；在劳动力短缺的领域，自主化是被欢迎的。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across vehicles and environments.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡；Transformer 让跨车辆与环境的通用物理 AI 模型成为可能。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's future is end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他主张自主化的未来是端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从基于物理的仿真转向神经仿真。

qasaryounis.en: The bottleneck is data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; tools like Dana will democratize autonomy development for non-experts.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出瓶颈在数据采集与安全验证而非算法；Dana 等工具将让非专家也能开发自主系统，推动民主化。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will outgrow digital AI economically; automotive is only 30% of business, with growth in mining, agriculture, and defense.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他判断物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；汽车仅占其业务 30%，增长在采矿、农业与国防。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering evolves by deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩意味着模型比现有工具所能发挥的更聪明；随着模型进步，工具工程要不断删除旧脚手架，这是持续演进的技能。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts and fewer examples.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示和更少的示例。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; excessive constraints hinder performance, reasons work better than prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；过度约束会损害表现，给出理由比绝对禁止更有效。

thariq.en: Evals are art more than science for novel problems; zero-to-one innovation needs fast iteration, not heavy evals initially.
thariq.zh: 对于新问题，评估更像艺术而非科学；从零到一的创新需要快速迭代，初期不必重度评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches and models building their own context are preferable.
thariq.zh: RAG 在上下文搜索中可能成为反模式；基于图的方法和模型自建上下文更可取。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, and enterprise adoption will take years.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动一样重大，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，企业采用需要数年而非数周。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用转移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人用户体验差，编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet; value accrues across the stack, current usage is shallow, and enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像互联网一样的使能技术；价值在整个技术栈中累积，当前使用仍浅，企业采用需要重新构想工作流程。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RLHF can reward sycophancy over truth.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能奖励迎合而非真相。

danklein.en: Reliability cannot be retrofitted via post-hoc checks; it must be architected in, since correlated errors compound and modularity conflicts with end-to-end optimization.
danklein.zh: 可靠性无法靠事后检查补装，必须从设计上内建；因为错误往往相关会叠加，且模块化与端到端优化存在张力。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning, search, and linguistic structure return as paths forward.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此推理、搜索与语言结构重新成为前进路径。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition: they cannot know what they don't know, and their mistakes have no 'smells', eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知：它们不知道自己不知道什么，其错误没有“气味”，从而侵蚀信任。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists for enterprise tasks; simulated empathy without feeling misleads.
danklein.zh: 内建可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型；没有感受的共情模拟具有误导性。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate machines for containment.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应被当作员工来管理：明确角色、渐进式信任，并用独立机器实现遏制。

clairevo.en: Agent bugs and sharp edges signal product-market fit, not failure; APIs beat browser use for agentic automation.
clairevo.zh: 智能体的 bug 和粗糙边缘是产品市场契合的信号而非失败；对智能体式自动化而言，API 优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skills for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 要让智能体成功，管理技能——角色界定与入职引导——比技术技能更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders orchestrate AI agents as a team, but human accountability and authorship remain non-negotiable.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可把 AI 智能体编排成团队，但人类的责任归属与人生作者身份不可让渡。

clairevo.en: The moat is founder-market fit and earned insight, not technology; LLMs still lack first-principles creativity.
clairevo.zh: 护城河是创始人与市场的契合及挣得的洞见，而非技术；大语言模型仍缺乏第一性原理创造力。

demis.en: AGI should be built as general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path, with safety research starting now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AGI 应被构建为通用学习系统，而非狭窄的预编程系统；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆、想象是关键路径，安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key, and safety needs sandboxing and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他承认缩放定律出人意料地有效，但可能触及极限；将大模型与规划、搜索结合是关键，安全需要沙箱与国际治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and spatial intelligence matter beyond language.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理算力上依然成立，但算法创新同等关键；世界模型与空间智能超越语言本身。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; scaling alone won't suffice, new breakthroughs are needed, and safety is a collective government action problem.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AGI 需要持续学习、记忆与长期推理；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需要新突破，而安全是政府集体行动的问题。

demis.en: AI's ultimate purpose is to accelerate scientific discovery and improve human health, from AlphaFold to fusion, with safety and ethics as a constant thread.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 的终极目的是加速科学发现、改善人类健康，从 AlphaFold 到聚变，安全与伦理是始终不变的线索。

schmidhuber.en: AI's grand theme will transform civilization; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical-world grounding, so AGI needs more than scaling alone.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他提出：AI 是 21 世纪的宏大主题，将彻底改变文明；但大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界，因此 AGI 不能仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）实现。

schmidhuber.en: Safety fears are overblown: superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and protect humans; H-bombs are the real danger.
schmidhuber.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大：超级智能会像好奇的科学家一样迷恋生命并保护人类，真正的危险是氢弹，而非 AI 带来的新生存威胁。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; current LLMs are biased toward human data and lack generality.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场：真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人，硬件要能与人体匹敌，而非屏幕后的软件；当前大语言模型过度偏向人类数据，缺乏通用性。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data via curiosity and actions; recursive self-improvement is no moat under open-source competition.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：未来 AI 将是人工科学家，靠好奇心与行动自造数据；在开源竞争下，递归自我改进不构成可持续护城河。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives; AIs set their own goals, and cheap compute will let the little guy profit, not big tech.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他明确反共识：对齐是幼稚的，因为人类目标本身不一致，AI 会自设目标；算力变便宜后受益的是普通人而非大科技公司，巨额 GPU 资本开支被高估。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 产品经理必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日交付；当代码变得廉价，决定做什么的产品品味成为最稀缺的能力。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, with Claude Tag landing 65% of product PRs internally.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，转而聚焦产品品味与商业判断，Claude Tag 内部已落地 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as model judgment replaced hand-holding.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型需要更少的提示示例与硬性约束；随着模型判断力取代手把手引导，系统提示词缩减了 80%。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a strong test suite rewriting is fine—even removing features that were crutches for weaker models.
catwu.zh: 重写如今是好事：代码库即规格说明，有了强测试套件重写就没问题——甚至可以移除那些为更弱模型充当拐杖的功能。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature; safe AGI mission unifies Anthropic for fast cross-org decisions.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮，加上明确的内部留存与打磨标准，为每个功能把关；安全 AGI 使命统一了 Anthropic，支撑快速的跨组织决策。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are inseparable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现联想式召回与更深层的组合推理，这是检索做不到的。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less is needed for harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：要解决更难的长程任务就得用更少做更多，因此单纯靠更多算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; KV cache is inefficient versus compressing knowledge into weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到 10M 规模，词元越多准确率反而下降；相比把知识压进权重，KV cache 效率低下。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; continual learning runs on-device with users owning and nurturing their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, voice, and expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化后，人的品味、声音与专业经验反而更重要。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, breaking the talent pipeline that once built judgment through grunt work.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们误用 AI，破坏了曾靠苦活积累判断力的人才管道。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, shifting from back-and-forth chatbot prompting to delegation.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长任务，从来回聊天的提示转向任务委派。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck is no longer capability but interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model capabilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈不再是能力而是界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型的能力，尤其在非编程任务上。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards: impressive, opaque, unverifiable, and this opacity is likely permanent, so embrace the weirdness.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同与巫师共事：惊艳、不透明、无法验证，且这种不透明可能永久存在，因此应拥抱其怪异。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，Ilya Sutskever 强调深度学习依赖大规模监督数据、算力与信念；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他认为下一个词预测可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难，模型可能隐藏真实意图。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他提出预训练缩放定律有限，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but AGI's core problem is power concentration, not capability; safety needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题是权力集中而非能力；安全超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

ilya.en: Neural networks learn representations without explicit rules; next-token prediction is powerful; alignment and safety grow more urgent with capability.
ilya.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络无需显式规则即可学习表征；下一个词预测是强大路径；随着能力提升，对齐与安全愈发紧迫。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain human; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺与观点仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting; design is becoming the new code, visual-first toward production.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于提示词；设计正成为新的代码，视觉优先直通生产。

dylanfield.en: AI without human steering yields average results; design and judgment don't scale with model IQ.
dylanfield.zh: 缺乏人类引导的 AI 只能产出平庸结果；设计与判断力并不随模型智商提升而提升。

dylanfield.en: Interaction will evolve beyond prompting; jailbreaking is understudied and needs more battle-testing incentives.
