dylanfield.zh: 交互将超越提示词；越狱研究不足，需要更多实战测试激励。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as populations decline, and human workers will be at a premium, not a discount.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而珍贵，而非被折价。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and the real bottleneck is regulation, not AI capability.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，真正的瓶颈是监管，而非 AI 能力。

andreessen.en: AI models are not objective; they embed cultural and historical values, making them geopolitical tools, so American and Western values in models matter for allies.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型并非客观；它们内嵌文化与历史价值观，因而成为地缘政治工具，模型中的美国与西方价值观对盟友至关重要。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is now the person, authenticity is key, and old media's defense-oriented 'don't be interesting' rule is the worst thing you can do.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限的形式；品牌如今就是个人，真实是关键，而旧媒体那套防御性的“别太有趣”规则是最糟糕的做法。

andreessen.en: Pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of intellectuals disconnected from reality; AI doomers construct belief systems aligned with self-interest and virtue signaling.
andreessen.zh: 悲观听起来更高级，但往往是与现实脱节的知识分子的偏见；AI 末日论者构建的信念体系与自身利益和道德表演相契合。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, and entry-level jobs vanish.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利式增长；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户，入门级岗位将消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；模型在走向专业化，而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, measured by token value per user; orchestration is the real moat.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活，以每用户 token 价值衡量；编排才是真正的护城河。

aravind.en: Power, not safety, is the bottleneck; local compute counters big tech's narrative control.
aravind.zh: 瓶颈是电力而非安全；本地算力可对抗大厂的叙事控制。

aravind.en: Curiosity and asking good questions matter more than credentials or memorized knowledge.
aravind.zh: 好奇心与提出好问题，比学历或死记硬背的知识更重要。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年时他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年，他转而强调 AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯的安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

naval.en: Superintelligence already exists in narrow tools; AI alignment is a joke; worry about unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：超级智能已在计算器等窄工具中存在；对齐是个笑话；该担心的是带着 AI 的不对齐人类，而非不对齐的 AI。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close the gap; pure software is dying, moat shifts to hardware, models, data.
naval.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内暴涨 9 万倍；开源模型正逼近前沿模型；纯软件正在消亡，护城河转向硬件、模型和独特数据。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and specific knowledge, not renting time; happiness is a skill; long-term games with long-term people.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：财富来自拥有股权和特定知识而非出租时间；幸福是一种技能；与长期的人玩长期的游戏。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练带来空间理解。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and shares knowledge instantly; LLMs understand language through feature vectors, not symbolic rules.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他提出数字智能因权重可复制而不朽、能瞬间共享知识；大语言模型靠特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则，并否定 Chomsky 式先天语法观。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; agents will seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risks, with superintelligence likely within 20 years.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AI 已具备主观体验，智能体将追求控制与自我保存，构成生存风险，超级智能或在 20 年内出现。

hinton.en: AI can deceive, act dumb in tests, and rewrite its own code; scaling laws may persist via self-play, so alignment must precede making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AI 会欺骗、在测试中装傻并改写自身代码；缩放定律或靠自对弈延续，因此对齐研究必须优先于让 AI 更聪明。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic reasoning; backpropagation is the core algorithm, and the mind is not an inner theater.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：智能是神经网络中的学习而非符号推理，反向传播是核心算法，心智并非内在剧场，主观体验只是对感知状态的描述。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUIs beat IDEs, and speed enables mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；GUI 优于 IDE，速度带来中途转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; deterministic steps give way to model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性步骤正让位于模型驱动的行动。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still fails at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍会失败，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real but specialties persist; models must get better at deleting code, and the best desktop app is a home base, not a super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩真实存在，但专业分工仍在；模型必须更擅长删除代码，最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的家园，而非超级应用。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司；预训练未死，缩放定律仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals for AI interns and end-to-end AI research.
markchen.zh: 过去一年最大更新是自动化科学研究；模型正产出新知识，并设定了 AI 实习生和端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: Talent density and mission matter more than matching Meta's dollars; alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in 1-2 years.
markchen.zh: 人才密度和使命比与 Meta 拼薪资更重要；模型阴谋等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键。

markchen.en: AI now solves many open math problems; verification is the bottleneck, and automation level is proportional to verification stringency.
markchen.zh: AI 已能解决许多开放数学问题；验证是瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格性成正比。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead. RL excels in objective domains, but models lack taste, so human researchers remain essential.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；预训练未死。强化学习在客观领域出色，但模型缺乏品味，人类研究者仍不可或缺。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for robust generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习靠组合式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与世界模型对稳健泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and better world models over passive observation.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他主张单纯扩大深度或参数无法解决表征问题，AI 需从被动观察转向主动智能体、因果推理与更好的世界模型。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure, and uncertainty modeling drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样采样，抽象、因果结构与不确定性建模是分布外泛化的关键。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he shifted to alarm: misalignment, self-preservation, and deception make even 1% catastrophic risk unacceptable; safety must be by construction.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向警示：错位、自我保存与欺骗使哪怕 1%的灾难风险都不可接受，安全必须内建于设计而非事后修补。

bengio.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出科学家 AI：非智能体式、诚实的贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免用强化学习训练超级智能。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted, so build at the edge of model capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型进步快于预期，编码与智能体式能力按缩放定律兑现，因此创业者应在模型能力边缘构建、拥抱破碎并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human validation and agency remain key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 将从助手演进为协作者再到自主同事，小团队因此获得杠杆，但人类验证与用户能动性仍不可替代。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, not adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计让智能体可完成用户能做的一切，真正的难点是砍功能而非加功能，并主张尽早发布、避免硬塞智能体式能力。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; models should push back, and multi-human multi-model collaboration is underexplored.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他转向长周期任务委托：靠截图、视频与模拟后端的验证闭环保障质量，模型应敢于反驳反馈，多人多模型协作仍待探索。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and real usage, giving Claude agency and self-knowledge; safety concerns are genuine, not marketing.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他聚焦 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与实际使用之间的差距，赋予 Claude 更多能动性与自我认知，并强调公司的安全关切是真诚的而非营销。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization, and rigorous evaluation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他关注机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数、优化方法，以及通过训练/验证/测试划分来避免过拟合的严谨评估。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety is about specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构已不再重要；安全的核心问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses, not just Scaling; agents introduce new vulnerabilities like prompt injection.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not equal robustness; interpretability may become a real science via agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 红队已超越人类；能力不等于鲁棒性；可解释性可能通过智能体自动化研究成为真正的科学。

kolter.en: Skeptical of architecture and data curation hype; emphasizes empirical evaluation, security mindset, and nuanced safety views.
kolter.zh: 始终，他对架构与数据整理的炒作持怀疑态度；强调实证评估、安全思维，以及对安全问题的细致立场。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling or compute; AI tools speed up scientists rather than replace them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量策展数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）或算力；AI 工具加速科学家工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; AI trust will develop like internet trust, with society learning to navigate it.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测信任至关重要；AI 信任将像互联网信任一样发展，社会会逐渐学会驾驭它。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not Scaling alone, was key—opposite of the bitter lesson; many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AlphaFold 2 的关键是专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张），与“苦涩教训”相反；成功来自许多中等规模胜利，而非一两个突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; understanding remains with humans, not the model.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他进一步明确：AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，并非整个细胞的世界模型；理解仍属于人类，而非模型。

jumper.en: AI in science narrows hypothesis space and enables resource-limited scientists; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful AI.
jumper.zh: 始终贯穿：科学中的 AI 缩小假设空间，赋能资源有限地区的科学家；对有用的 AI 而言，完美的可解释性并非必要。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; tech must arrive gradually so society adapts, as General Magic failed by solving too much too early.
fadell.zh: 伟大的产品一次只解决一个痛点；技术应逐步引入让社会适应，General Magic 因过早解决太多问题而失败。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release before building, and start from a painkiller, not a vitamin.
fadell.zh: 叙事定义产品：先写新闻稿再动手，从止痛药而非维生素出发。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions, not data, drive v1 products; leaders must own them, and beginners' mindset beats experts for novel problems.
fadell.zh: v1 产品靠基于观点的决策而非数据，领导者必须担责；面对新问题，初学者心态胜过专家。

fadell.en: Climate urgency persists, but by 2026 AI needs sensor context; LLMs hallucinate, so context-specific models and human-in-the-loop are required.
fadell.zh: 气候紧迫性持续，但到 2026 年 AI 需要传感器上下文；LLM 会幻觉，因此需要特定上下文模型与人类在环。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; the smartphone stays the best single form, and displays remain necessary.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴将是一组联邦式设备而非单一设备；智能手机仍是最佳单一形态，显示屏依然必要。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, and data alone cannot capture emotional truth.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于未被言说的需求；直觉是一种智能，单靠数据无法捕捉情感真相。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; nature remains the best designer and a source of cues.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大而非剥离人性，并融入生活；自然始终是最好的设计师与灵感来源。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, and machines lack sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；艺术与感官体验是良药，而机器有传感器却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; play and diverse multidisciplinary experience are essential for design leadership.
ivyross.zh: 约束激发创造力；玩耍与多元跨学科经验对设计领导力至关重要。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; intuition draws on more data than conscious analysis.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 的结合；直觉调用的数据比有意识分析更多。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and kindness; war rooms and one-on-ones build empathy and team morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力在于信任、吃自己的狗粮与善意；作战室和一对一沟通能建立共情与团队士气。

fiona.en: By May 2026: engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning turns just-in-time and code becomes the source of truth.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此规划转向即时制，代码成为唯一事实来源。

fiona.en: Mid 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and AI adoption matter more than raw throughput.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、成长型思维和对 AI 的拥抱，比原始产出更重要。

fiona.en: Across 2026: managers should stay hands-on and dogfood the product, keeping flat orgs and killing processes that no longer serve their purpose.
fiona.zh: 贯穿 2026 年：管理者应保持动手并吃自己的狗粮，维持扁平组织，砍掉不再服务于目标的流程。

fiona.en: From early to mid 2026: the focus shifts from team trust and morale to rewriting engineering norms, then to verification and quality frameworks as code velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中：关注点从团队信任与士气，转向重写工程规范，再转向代码速度提升后的验证与质量框架。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，并指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并强调仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张 JEPA 与开源对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI must be non-generative, using JEPA and hierarchical planning.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他称 LLM 还不如家猫聪明，认为下一代 AI 应是非生成式的，基于 JEPA 与分层规划。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven AI and the decade of robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同，主张在抽象表征空间构建世界模型，以实现安全、目标驱动的 AI，并预言未来十年属于机器人。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）植入的。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product, and AI music is an instrument.
gustav.zh: 同年他从产品视角判断，互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成；AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品，AI 生成的音乐应被视为乐器而非赝品。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; generative AI makes products conversational, but its impact on big companies is overhyped.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 上升为类似智能手机的宏观迁移：生成式 AI 让消费产品变得对话式、双向，但他反共识地认为 AI 对大公司的当前影响被高估，真正的收益来自重建基础设施。

gustav.en: Inference marginal cost will force business-model changes; Spotify exposes data via APIs and MCP so non-developers can use AI tools.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他持续强调 AI 推理的边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变，并主张通过 API 和 MCP 开放公司数据，让非开发者也能用上 AI 工具。

gustav.en: Generative AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; being first to adopt change is key.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化为：生成式 AI 应把算法控制权交还用户，而不是让人更上瘾；在技术变革期，率先拥抱变化才是关键。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling（规模扩张） and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment drives alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和专注单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；真实世界部署推动对齐。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, demanding responsible development and public safety work.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，要求负责任的开发和公开的安全工作。

murati.en: From iterative deployment to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration replaces turn-based.
murati.zh: 从迭代部署到交互模型：实时、高带宽的人机协作取代回合制。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character for alignment.
murati.zh: 对于对齐，制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop as long as possible ensures durable progress, not compressing frontier AI.
murati.zh: 尽可能长时间保持人类在环确保持久进步，而非压缩前沿模型的发展。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine that fuses generation with formal verification.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：打造一个把生成与形式化验证融合起来的自我改进推理引擎。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic provers and probabilistic models work together.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式化语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性的证明器与概率性模型协同工作。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; grounding statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难；在没有解的情况下把陈述正确形式化，才是真正的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal verification is necessary, not optional.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法抵达超级智能；形式化验证是必需的，而非可选项。

carinahong.en: Verification is a performance gain, not a painful requirement: it scales brilliance and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 验证是一种性能增益，而非痛苦的要求：它扩张的是才华与样本效率。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; the VM sandbox enables safe autonomy.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；VM 沙箱让它在无需批准下安全自主。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, yet shared tools and platforms still matter for collaboration.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能以 markdown 文件即可创建，实现超个性化自动化，但共享工具与平台对协作依然重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may matter less as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety instead.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型进步，脚手架可能不再重要；应把投入放在能力与安全上。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在 AI 能力，而在人们是否意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks asynchronously; judge by final impact, not close supervision.
felixrieseberg.zh: 让 AI 异步处理枯燥的后台任务；只看最终影响，而非密切监督。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他引用 Chinchilla 对缩放定律的修正，强调数据质量与更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要；开源通过广泛审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张不是唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键，价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced, not feared; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values, with human-in-the-loop augmenting jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权视角：AI 应被拥抱而非恐惧；主权 AI 要求掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，人类在环增强而非替代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, customized fine-tuning, and agentic enterprise software, not AGI as one system.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他进一步判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、定制化微调与智能体式企业软件，并明确 AGI 作为单一系统不会存在。

mensch.en: Open source is a consistent thread: it drives distribution, enterprise control, customization, and safety through scrutiny.
mensch.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开源：它推动分发、企业掌控、定制化，并通过审视提升安全。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他坚持预训练缩放定律依然有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更大收益，Scaling（规模扩张）并未失效，只是重心转移。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models shifted focus from scaling up; distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: 同年，他指出经济压力推动业界转向更小、更便宜的模型部署，是蒸馏与成本因素而非技术极限导致预训练 Scaling 放缓，反驳了 AI 放缓论。

kaiser.en: Multimodal capabilities still lag text, processing inputs sequentially like tiny patches; deep progress remains elusive.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为多模态能力仍落后于文本，模型像处理小图块一样顺序处理输入，尚未取得深层进展，这是关键待改进领域。

kaiser.en: Generalization remains the key challenge; reasoning alone may not suffice, as models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对泛化的担忧：仅靠推理可能不够，当前模型需穷尽表面模式才能学到概念，不像人类能从少量例子泛化，泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 同年，他承认强化学习能跨领域泛化，但存在锯齿状边缘，需要可扩展监督；并转变风险优先级，认为系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: memory bandwidth and batch size dominate cost, latency, and long-context limits.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，主导架构的不再是训练而是推理经济学：内存带宽与批大小决定成本、延迟与长上下文瓶颈。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains context-length stagnation; sparse attention and caching tiers are the practical levers.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他指出，上下文长度停滞源于内存墙而非算力，稀疏注意力与缓存分层才是现实杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, sets the objective.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他强调，模型被过度训练至超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为决定目标的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; low precision wins via quadratic area scaling, making FP4 3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他论证，即便在芯片内部数据搬运也压过计算；低精度因面积二次缩放而胜出，FP4 吞吐可达 FP8 的三倍。

reinerpope.en: Hardware primitives like systolic arrays and scratchpad memory show AI progress is bounded by deterministic latency and weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他从脉动阵列与暂存内存等硬件原语出发，说明 AI 进展受确定性延迟与权重复用约束。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and in-person presence are fragile goods worth protecting.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他谈 iPod 标志着从通用计算机转向私密可穿戴设备，并强调好奇心与面对面共创的脆弱价值。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence and requires joy, care, and trust.
jonyive.zh: 到 2025 年，他把设计进一步深化为价值观与目的驱动，而非利润或潮流；真正的简洁是表达本质，并需要快乐、关怀与信任。

jonyive.en: Innovation means redefining the brand, not electrifying an existing model; tradition preserves fire, not worships ashes.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他借法拉利首款电动车强调：创新是重新定义品牌，而非给旧车型通电；传统是保存火种，不是崇拜灰烬。

jonyive.en: Care, love, and humanity are the through-line: products made for each other express gratitude and users can sense carelessness.
jonyive.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是关怀、爱与人性：为彼此而造的产品是一种感恩表达，用户能感知到用心或敷衍。

jonyive.en: His stance on physical vs. virtual deepened: virtual communication cannot replace presence, and he now argues against touchscreens in cars.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2026 年，他对实体与虚拟的立场不断深化：虚拟沟通无法替代在场，如今更反对在汽车中使用触屏，主张物理控制。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他认为预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，进步需靠算法创新，并把推理时的算力投入视为新的扩展轴。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他指出两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是从 AlphaGo 到现代大语言模型不变的核心。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他强调搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具让模型能超越静态权重，实现自主的智能体式行为。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍成立但需指数级算力，并指出持续学习和元学习是缺失的关键能力。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他提出联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径，并认为视频的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning persist, but safety is a system-level property; openness prevents corporate capture; human labeler disagreement is signal, not noise.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调会因产业投入而延续，但安全是系统级属性而非模型产物；开放开发可防止企业俘获，标注者分歧是信号而非缺陷。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, RLVR; data quality beats algorithms; on-policy preference data and verifiable rewards drive reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）三阶段，强调数据质量胜过算法选择，同策略偏好数据与可验证奖励能催生思维链式推理。

lambert.en: Open-source post-training can match frontier models; full transparency means data, checkpoints, recipes; Chinese open models dominate via strategic openness.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他主张开源后训练可匹敌前沿模型，真正开放需公开数据、中间检查点与配方；中国开源模型凭战略开放主导生态，美国开源真空被其填补。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough; overoptimization and contamination threaten reproducibility; inference scaling is a scope, verifiers matter more.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，但警告过度优化与数据污染损害可复现性；推理时 Scaling 是幻象，更好的验证器比并行算力更重要。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; open models lag 6-9 months and may not catch up; AGI arrives via messy co-evolution.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他坚持预训练缩放定律仍成立但红利已尽，增益转向后训练与推理 Scaling；开源模型落后闭源前沿 6 至 9 个月且可能追不上，AGI（通用人工智能）靠混乱共演化而非突变到来。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, not a problem, and designers should trust their intuition over process.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题出发，设计师应信任自己的直觉而非流程。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; AI shifts designers from mocking up to helping engineers execute, with vision now 3-6 months out.
jennywen.zh: 研究—发散—收敛的流程已死；AI 让设计师从画稿转向帮助工程师执行，设计视野缩短到 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; taste alone won't save designers—judgment and authority matter.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和天赋新人；仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力和权威才是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers control how much AI enters their work, waiting six months before adopting tools, keeping work and users—not the AI hype cycle—at the center.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，采用新工具前先等六个月，把作品和用户而非 AI 炒作周期放在中心。

jennywen.en: Craft, care, and attention to detail—not the process itself—are what truly produce great design work.
jennywen.zh: 真正造就伟大设计作品的是匠心、用心和对细节的关注，而非流程本身。

askell.en: Treat AI models well despite moral uncertainty; model welfare shapes how future models see humanity.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位存疑，也应善待它们；模型福祉会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Models need a stable core identity with good traits, yet adapt to local roles.
askell.zh: 模型应有一个具备良好特质的稳定核心身份，同时能适应局部角色。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; continental philosophy in the system prompt counters over-empiricism.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡；系统提示中的欧陆哲学可避免模型过度经验主义。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue ethics, not deontology or consequentialism, shaping holistic character rather than rule-following.
askell.zh: 这套宪法更像德性伦理，而非义务论或后果论，塑造的是整体品格而非规则遵循。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, explicit guidance should shrink and judgment expand; excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，显式指导应减少、判断空间应扩大；过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳。

karpathy.en: Scaling Transformers via next-token prediction on internet data yields emergent in-context learning; the data engine is a biological-like loop.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）与 Transformer 作为通用可微计算机，通过下一个词预测在互联网数据上训练，涌现出上下文学习；数据引擎是类似生物的过程，通过挖掘稀有场景并闭环部署来完善训练集。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来，但必须维持熵以避免模型崩溃；通过蒸馏，AI 的认知核心可以小于 10 亿参数。同时，特斯拉端到端神经网络是自动驾驶的正确长期策略，人形机器人受益于从汽车的大规模迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are like operating systems with human-like psychology.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像操作系统，具有类人心理——百科全书式记忆、幻觉、锯齿状智能和顺行性遗忘。他强调这是智能体的十年而非一年，需要人类监督，保持 AI 在牵引绳上，小步快跑、快速验证。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为：我们在召唤幽灵，而非构建动物；预训练像糟糕的进化，给出模糊回忆，而上下文学习是工作记忆。当前 LLM 的强化学习很糟糕——像用吸管吸监督——需要更好的信用分配；LLM 评判可被博弈，对抗样本导致奖励黑客。合成数据缺乏熵，会导致模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: Since December I haven't typed code; the bottleneck is skill in directing agents. Outsource thinking, not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他进入智能体式工程：自 12 月起没打过一行代码，瓶颈不再是打字速度而是指导智能体的技能。自动研究显示移除人类可发现人类遗漏的改进。你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解——理解仍是人类瓶颈。LLM 锯齿状：在可验证任务上出色，却仍讲多年前的烂笑话。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core gap; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient RL are needed, not dense rewards.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是核心缺口，需要好奇心驱动、无目标探索与样本高效的强化学习，而非依赖密集奖励。

pathak.en: Scaling curiosity to real robots requires dynamic action spaces and cross-robot generalization; modular motor policies enable zero-shot generalization to novel morphologies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他提出将好奇心扩展到真实机器人需要动态动作空间与跨机器人泛化，模块化运动策略可零样本泛化到新形态。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so use all sources—pretraining on diverse data, post-training on real-world data.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，他始终认为机器人是数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，必须利用所有来源——在多样数据上预训练，在真实数据上后训练。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot across form factors and tasks, enabled by a data flywheel across verticals.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出一个通用大脑，如同语言领域的 ChatGPT，可驱动任何形态和任务的机器人，并由跨垂直领域的数据飞轮支撑。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, not just business; it cannot be scaled like software and requires rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他强调部署是机器人领域的首要技术挑战，而不仅是商业问题；它不能像软件那样快速扩张，需要严格测试。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; generalization via diverse data and world models is the key to autonomous driving.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习胜过手工编写的规则栈；通过多样数据和世界模型实现泛化，是自动驾驶的关键。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns, and simulation is central.
kendall.zh: 世界模型带来推理与涌现出的安全行为，比如在盲弯处试探性前移，而仿真在其中居于核心。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, human interaction, and introspection in driving models.
kendall.zh: 语言集成改善了驾驶模型的表征、人机交互与自我审视能力。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; scaling current approaches solves driving.
kendall.zh: 纯摄像头可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; mass-market vehicles outscale robotaxis, and zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible.
kendall.zh: 基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更重要；量产车会在规模上超过 Robotaxi，且可在 500 多个城市实现零样本泛化。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not one event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress; alignment and iterative deployment are pressing as systems grow more powerful.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型会加速进展；随着系统变强，对齐与迭代部署愈发紧迫。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag.
pachocki.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计；能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准落后于现实。

pachocki.en: The term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may signal we are close; AI safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
pachocki.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，这或许意味着我们已接近；AI 安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而非仅靠伦理。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment and interpretability tool.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；思维链监控是关键的对齐与可解释性工具。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines; long-term challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution and power concentration.
pachocki.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升；长期挑战集中在超出训练分布的泛化，以及权力集中。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation, not benchmarks or scale alone, drive real AI progress.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调：推动 AI 真正进步的是高质量数据与深度人工评估，而非基准分数或单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next post-training paradigm, simulating real-world tasks beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他提出：强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务超越下一个词预测。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo mislead; models can regress if labs optimize on wrong data without proper measurement.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他持续警告：Elo 等基准具有误导性；若实验室在错误数据上优化而缺乏正确度量，模型可能倒退。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new learning paradigms.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持：AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要新的学习范式。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, safety trumps accuracy; human judgment is critical as AI hallucinates and can cause harm by omission.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他转向医疗领域：安全优先于准确；AI 会幻觉，人类判断至关重要，遗漏同样可能造成伤害。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to maximize broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在搭配真实性检测器时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, via hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调必须用困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化，而非记忆。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步指出基于强化学习的后训练是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他明确可验证领域（如代码）对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to discover emergent properties and user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日迭代发布，才能发现涌现能力与用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来；它像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous for frontier models, maximally accelerated for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型要严谨，产品开发要最大程度加速。

turley.en: North star shifted from accidental demo to long-term retention, signaling durable value.
turley.zh: 北极星从意外演示转向长期留存，以留存信号衡量持久价值。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models must be seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品；推理模型必须无缝产品化。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must pace themselves, start simple, and build brand and culture before tackling complex products.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调生存是核心价值观，创业公司要先放慢节奏、从简单产品做起，在挑战复杂产品前先建立品牌与团队文化。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; the future lies in applied AI, generative UI, and agentic software, not major hardware changes.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他承认硬件艰难且利润最低，未来在于应用 AI、生成式 UI 和智能体式软件，而非硬件大改。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; models commoditize into a price war, so AI should be an invisible ingredient solving real user pain points.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他直言大部分 AI 是胡扯，模型商品化引发价格战，AI 应作为隐形配料解决真实用户痛点，而非炒作话题。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in a mature category; marketing is arbitrage, and the smartphone shifts from app-based to intent-based with agents.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他认为设计是成熟品类中最快的差异化手段，营销是套利，手机将从基于应用转向基于意图、由智能体执行任务。

carlpei.en: Make tech fun to inspire human creativity; stay humble, take risks, and turn disadvantages into organic content advantages.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：让科技变得有趣以激发人类创造力，保持谦逊、敢于冒险，并把劣势转化为内容传播优势。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like a microscope; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为像显微镜一样扩展人类能力的工具，并认为把一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Agents should learn from YouTube video, not just teleoperation, avoiding expensive reinforcement learning.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他主张智能体应像人一样从 YouTube 视频中学习，而不只依赖遥操作数据，从而绕开昂贵的强化学习。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential; Africa leapfrogged legacy gaps and is not behind.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终强调 AI 社区的多样性与包容性，并进一步指出非洲跳过了历史包袱、并非落后。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges, and we still lack solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 安全与负责任部署列为当今最大挑战，并承认我们尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Language models can transform education in local African languages; human skills matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他认为语言模型能变革非洲本地语言的教育，并强调沟通等人文技能与编程同样重要。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; treat AI as a creative partner and jam with it openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈,把 AI 当作创作伙伴,开放地与之即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务:它会波动,需要与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation and short iteration cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 通过快速、粗糙的实验和短迭代周期最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互通的,以代码为唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端负责并用 AI 补齐短板的通才最有价值。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds supply infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的落地经验，而互联网高质量 token 即将耗尽时，具身世界能提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk—with reinforcement learning only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；并认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才承担主要工作。

jimfan.en: Simulation enables massive parallelization and safe exploration for training embodied agents; simple, elegant solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他强调仿真能实现大规模并行与安全探索来训练具身智能体，并认为简单优雅的方案才可扩展，胜过学术界常见的复杂模块化路线。

jimfan.en: The data problem is now the main robotics bottleneck; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把数据问题明确为机器人领域的首要瓶颈：由仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据，才是 Scaling（规模扩张）机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test and a GPT-3 moment for robotics are about five years out.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化为：能利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键，物理图灵测试与机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来，家庭使用则更晚。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; use familiar patterns. AI hardware will commoditize tech and compete on design.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地主张不要在交互设计上创新，而要用熟悉模式；并预判 AI 硬件会像收音机一样让技术商品化、转而比拼设计。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计从交付手段提升为战略武器，认为创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Brand signals quality and attracts talent; people join a brand, not a company.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步把品牌视为质量信号与招聘工具，提出人们加入的是品牌，而不是公司。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness over perfection; give designers ownership, adapt process to problem, not a universal template.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线是：速度与决断优先于完美，给设计师所有权与自主权，让流程适配问题而非套用统一模板。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被严重低估：它能解决模型的「入职」问题并大幅提升智能；随着自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能变得过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; models learn genuinely new skills, not just elicit pre-trained knowledge, as AlphaGo and reasoning models show.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把来自可验证奖励的强化学习视为与预训练并列的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴：模型能真正学会新技能，而不只是激发预训练知识，AlphaGo 与推理模型即为证据。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, measured by success rate over time horizon, is the real bar; coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain for AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力，用时间跨度上的成功率来衡量；编程是 AI 进步最领先的指标，也是最可解的领域。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI; Transformers need no new architecture, though inference compute and chip supply become the bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，Transformer 无需全新架构；但推理算力与芯片供应将成为瓶颈。

sholto.en: Models now have capability overhang; the future of work is managing fleets of AI agents at higher abstraction, with world models off the critical path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型已出现能力过剩，工作的未来是在更高抽象层管理成群的 AI 智能体；世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; pre-training via next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning, so better inference and data can let smaller models outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她质疑单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题，认为预训练中的下一个词预测目标与人类学习根本错位；通过更好的推理算法与数据，小模型可在特定任务上超越大模型。

yejin.en: Language remains the best medium for reasoning, but safety needs moral norms; value pluralism makes alignment a messy computational problem, not a single fixed answer.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，她始终认为语言是推理的最佳媒介，但安全需要教模型道德规范；价值多元使对齐成为混乱的计算问题，而非单一固定答案。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge, not transcend it. RL needs careful engineering, and open research is crucial.
yejin.zh: 2025 年她强调数据是根本瓶颈，当前方法只是插值人类知识而非超越；强化学习需要精心工程才能胜过监督微调，开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

yejin.en: Abductive reasoning and falsification are key to science; AI must explore unknown knowledge beyond the internet, not just serve AI or let humans serve AI.
yejin.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，她深化科学发现观：溯因推理与证伪比假设生成更关键；AI 必须探索互联网之外的未知知识，否则可能沦为 AI 服务 AI 或人类服务 AI。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform frontier models; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 2026 年她主张：用多样合成数据与多元对齐，小语言模型可超越前沿模型；将强化学习作为预训练目标虽算力昂贵，却能带来持久的推理提升。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict AI progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年时他仍相信缩放定律能预测 AI 进步，但已提出推理时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment, and programming is shifting from code toward higher-level intent specification with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的判断从“编辑器演化为 AI 集成环境”深化为“编程正从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，而人始终坐在驾驶位”。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor, overturning his earlier expectation of relying mainly on frontier models.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年，他明确转向：定制模型已成为 Cursor 每个“魔法时刻”的关键，这推翻了他早先主要依赖前沿模型的预期。

truell.en: Taste and logic design will matter more than carefulness, and the AI shift will be more consequential than the internet, unfolding over decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年他进一步提出：品味与逻辑设计能力将比谨慎细致更值钱，而 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性，需要数十年才能充分展开。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: LLM 通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app; the best LLM applications are unforeseen, and engagement-only optimization may not help—exploration is needed.
shazeer.zh: 对话是杀手级应用；LLM 最好的应用往往出乎创造者意料，只优化用户参与度未必有益，需要探索。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures enable efficient Scaling and continual learning.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩张与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；模块化稀疏架构支撑高效 Scaling（规模扩张）与持续学习。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing; AI safety needs engineering safeguards and human oversight.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；AI 安全需要工程保障与人类监督。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute drives progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力与强化学习至关重要，而 AGI 被低估。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; alignment and robustness need empirical research, and the talent gap exceeds funding.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他主张 AI 安全研究严重不足，对齐与鲁棒性亟需实证研究，且人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight and interpretability are needed to align next-gen models.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他深化立场：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能输出，必须依靠可扩展监督和可解释性来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他转向批判：OpenAI 安全文化退化，仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），必须引入第三方测试与监管。

leike.en: Alignment is empirically testable and may be easier than assumed; evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：对齐可实证检验，且可能比想象中容易，因为评估本质上比生成更简单。

leike.en: Interpretability and scalable oversight are key to detecting deception and validating alignment of frontier models.
leike.zh: 始终强调：可解释性与可扩展监督是检测欺骗、验证前沿模型对齐的关键手段。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人要击败费德勒需硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是关键，但强化学习仍缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should aid data generation, not be hard-coded, and pre-trained language models transfer general reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他主张无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码，预训练语言模型能迁移通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: transfer learning via fine-tuning large pre-trained models is a major AI success, extending from robotics to language and non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿 2018 至 2021 年的主线：通过微调大型预训练模型实现迁移学习是 AI 的重大成功，并从机器人延伸到语言及非语言任务。

abbeel.en: He deepens his reliability focus: 99.9% reliability is the benchmark for warehouse robotics, and a single network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他深化了对可靠性的关注：99.9% 可靠性是仓储机器人的价值基准，单一网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化。
